title: Overview
text:
Cinematic Zoom Extended 
 A configurable zoom with animated cinema bars and two profiles. 
  
 Hold a key and the view eases in while bars slide across the screen. Let go and it eases back. Runs on Fabric, Quilt, Forge and NeoForge, from 1.20.1 to 26.3. 
 
 A fork of  Cinematic Zoom (Fabric)  by  Mel1x , based on  Cinematic Zoom  by  KubePixel . Published with permission ( PR #8 ). Not affiliated with or endorsed by Mojang, Microsoft, Mel1x or KubePixel.

title: Use
text:
Use 
  
 Click the view, then use the keys.  Esc  lets go of the mouse. 
 Two profiles 
  
 Ultra-wide 
  
 With  Allow ultrawide zoom , the wheel goes past 1× down to 0.5×. 

 Snap targets   
  Target values  list zooms ( 2x ) or fields of view ( 45fov ,  45deg ,  45° ). With  Magnetize zoom targets  on, each wheel notch goes to the next one. 
 Aspect ratios   
 Auto, 2.39:1, 2.35:1, 2:1, 1.85:1, 16:9, 16:10, 4:3 and 1:1. Add your own, or reorder them. Wider than the window adds top and bottom bars. Narrower adds side bars. 
 Left and right cycle them during cinematic zoom. Turn on global cycling to pick one outside zoom. Each change has its own Instant, Linear or Smooth mode. 
 Curves   
 Keys 
  
   Key  Does   
 
   C   Zooms with bars. Hold, or press once with  Toggle zoom  on.  
   V   Zooms without bars, with its own settings.  
  Wheel  Changes magnification while zoomed, with a tick for each step.  
   ↑   ↓   Changes bar height by 1%, with the  Legacy  aspect ratio.  
   ←   →   Cycles aspect ratios.  
   
 Rebind under  Controls → Key Binds → Cinematic Zoom . Nothing zooms while a screen such as the inventory is open. 
 Music goes quiet while you zoom and comes back after. Turn off  Mute music while zooming  to keep it. 
 Spyglass 
 Set  Spyglass zoom  to Cinematic or Regular and a spyglass zooms with that profile instead of showing its scope. The zoom lasts as long as you hold the spyglass up. The zoom keys do nothing while it's on. 
 Replays 
 Zoom works in  Flashback  replays, with the same keys.

title: Configure
text:
Configure 
  
 Open  Mod Menu → Cinematic Zoom Extended → Settings , or your loader's mod list on Forge and NeoForge. 
 Settings 
 Saved in  config/cinematiczoom/config.json . Delete it to reset. 
  
 
 
 Setting 
 Default 
 Notes 
 
 
 
 
 Starting zoom 
  3×  
 Per profile. 
 
 
 Black bars height 
  15%  
 Cinematic profile, with the  Legacy  aspect ratio.  ↑   ↓  adjust it by  1% . 
 
 
 Zoom in and out duration 
  240 ms  
 Per profile. 
 
 
 Zoom in and out curve 
 Exponential 
 Per profile. 
 
 
 Hide HUD, crosshair and hands while zooming 
 On 
 Per profile. 
 
 
 Toggle zoom 
 Off 
 Hold the key by default. 
 
 
 Mute music while zooming 
 On 
 Sets the Music volume to 0 while zoomed and puts it back after. 
 
 
 Tick when scrolling 
 On 
 A soft tick for each wheel step, higher going in and lower going out. 
 
 
 Spyglass zoom 
 Off 
 Cinematic or Regular makes a spyglass zoom with that profile instead of its scope. 
 
 
 Mouse wheel during zoom 
 On 
 Changes magnification while zooming. 
 
 
 Allow ultrawide zoom 
 Off 
 Allows zooming out to  0.5× . 
 
 
 Target values 
 Empty 
 Per profile. See  Snap targets . 
 
 
  
 Older configs, including Cinematic Zoom 1.3's, migrate on launch, with a backup in  config/cinematiczoom/backups . With no config yet, the first launch copies settings from Zoomify, Ok Zoomer, Just Zoom or any JSON or TOML file with  zoom  in its path, and leaves those files as they are.

title: Troubleshooting
text:
Troubleshooting 
  
 
 
 Problem 
 Fix 
 
 
 
 
  requires cloth-config2  
 Install Cloth Config for your Minecraft version. 
 
 
  requires modmenu  
 Install Mod Menu for your Minecraft version. 
 
 
  incompatible with cinematiczoom  
 Keep only one Cinematic Zoom jar in  mods . 
 
 
 Crash on launch 
 Check Java: 17, 21 or 25, depending on Minecraft. 
 
 
 Settings screen missing 
 Install both Mod Menu and Cloth Config. 
 
 
 Zoom key does nothing 
 Bind  Cinematic Zoom  under  Controls . 
 
 
 Wheel doesn't zoom 
 Enable  Mouse wheel during zoom  and hold the zoom key. 
 
 
 Bars don't appear 
 Use the cinematic key and set the bar height above 0. 
 
 
 Broken config 
 Delete  config/cinematiczoom/config.json  and relaunch. 
 
 
  
  Report issues  with  logs/latest.log  and your Minecraft, mods and loader versions. 
 Limits 
 
 Only one Cinematic Zoom build can be installed, so the original can't run alongside it. 
 Other zoom mods may conflict with FOV handling. Don't run them together. Import their settings instead. 
 Sodium, Iris and shaders have no known conflicts, but aren't specifically tested. 
 Quilt is tested with the actual loader on every Fabric version. See the  verification report . 
 Each Forge and NeoForge jar loads only on its exact Minecraft version. 
 OptiFine isn't supported.

title: Changelog
text:
Changelog 
 [1.3.0] - 2026-11-12 
 Added 
 
 Spyglass zoom: a setting in General that makes a spyglass zoom with the cinematic or regular profile instead of showing its scope. The zoom lasts as long as you hold the spyglass up, and the zoom keys do nothing while it's on. Off by default. (#9) 
 Mute music while zooming: the Music volume setting goes to 0 while zoomed and back when the zoom ends. On by default. 
 Scroll ticks: a soft tick for each mouse wheel step while zooming, higher going in and lower going out. On by default. 
 
 Fixed 
 
 Flashback: zoom works in replays. Flashback's replay camera set its own FOV and skipped the zoom. (#10) 
 
 [1.2.0] - 2026-11-06 
 Changed 
 
 Everything the mod saves is now in  config/cinematiczoom/ :  config.json  and  backups/ . Files from older versions move there on launch. 
 
 [1.1.0] - 2026-11-04 
 Added 
 
 Forge and NeoForge: native builds for 1.20.1, 1.21.1, 1.21.5, 1.21.7, 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.2, and 26.3, plus NeoForge 1.21.2. Forge published no 1.21.2 loader. Each jar loads only on its exact Minecraft version. 
 Aspect ratio profiles: Auto, 2.39:1, 2.35:1, 2:1, 1.85:1, 16:9, 16:10, 4:3, and 1:1, plus custom ratios. Ratios wider than the window add top and bottom bars. Narrower ratios add side bars. 
 Profile cycling:  ←  and  →  switch ratios during cinematic zoom. Enable global cycling to switch outside zoom. The selection is saved. 
 Bar animation: entry, exit, and profile changes each have their own Instant, Linear, or Smooth mode and duration. 
 Accurate magnification up to 500× for new installations. 
 Forge settings: a built-in settings screen on 1.21.1 and newer, with no Cloth Config or Mod Menu needed. 
 
 Changed 
 
 Zoom without bars: bind it to  V  by default. Players who already set this key keep their choice. 
 Jar names: Fabric jars now include the loader, such as  cinematic-zoom-extended-1.21.2-1.21.4-fabric-1.1.0.jar . 
 26.2: this jar now covers 26.2 only. 26.2.1 and 26.2.2 have no Fabric builds to test against. 
 Existing settings: saved configs keep their FOV behavior, percentage bars, and zoom limits. Migration writes  cinematiczoom.json.v1.bak  first. 
 Repository: use  cinematic-zoom-extended  for GitHub, the Gradle project, and new build filenames. Existing release downloads, mod identity, key binds, and saved settings keep their names and contents. 
 CurseForge publishing: read the version and artifact prefix from  gradle.properties , and upload every loader. 
 Update source, issue, release, and badge links to the renamed repository. 
 Wiki: interactive and animated zoom views, run on the mod's zoom code over the game's title screen panorama. Add left and right aspect presets and letterbox and pillarbox visuals. 
 Add the CurseForge release sheet, configuration defaults, and repository instructions using the shared templates standard. 
 
 [1.0.0] - 2026-10-20 
 First release, based on Cinematic Zoom 1.3 by Mel1x. 
 Added 
 
 Cinematic (bars) and Regular (no bars) zoom profiles with separate keys, zoom, timing, curves, toggle mode, snap targets, and HUD settings. 
 Per-frame smoothing with six easing curves. 
 Live arrow-key bar adjustment, ultra-wide zoom, discrete wheel steps, and snap/magnetize targets ( 2x ,  45fov ). 
 Sensitivity scaling, view-bobbing removal, and independent HUD/crosshair/hands hiding. 
 512×512 Extended icon. 
 First-run import from Zoomify, Ok Zoomer, Just Zoom, and other zoom-named configs. 
 Config migration from Cinematic Zoom 1.3. 
 40 headless regression checks. 
 
 Changed 
 
 New mod ID  cinematiczoom_extended  and name  Cinematic Zoom Extended ; original  cinematiczoom  declared incompatible. 
 Cloth Config and Mod Menu are now required. 
 Fixed Fabric API and Cloth Config declarations on 26.x. 
 Version now comes from  gradle.properties ; JARs use  cinematiczoom-extended-<minecraft>-<version>.jar . 
 Updated metadata, links, translations, and credits. 
 
 Fixed 
 
 Profile switching preserves the current zoom. 
 HUD, crosshair, and hands hide independently. 
 26.x builds no longer rely on undeclared runtime dependencies. 
 Unix  gradlew  wrapper is executable.

title: Develop
text:
Develop 
 Requires JDK 25. 1.20.1 compiles with  --release 17 , and 1.21.x with 21. 
  ./gradlew clean test buildAll
  
 The jars are in  build/libs/ . 
 Targets 
 To build one target: 
  ./gradlew -PonlyTarget=1.21.7 :1.21.7:build
  
 See  multi-loader development  for native builds, pinned dependencies and real-client tests.
